metadata.title: Positive scalar curvature on products of noncompact manifolds
metadata.abstract: We prove that the product of three connected noncompact smooth manifolds without boundary admits a complete metric of uniformly positive scalar curvature. The proof uses the additivity of Morse indices on products and an orientation-free version of Das's open Morse--surgery construction. We also give an example of two open manifolds whose product admits no complete metric of nonnegative scalar curvature.

analysis.progressType: 开放流形乘积的正标量曲率
analysis.workSummary: 证明任意三个连通无边界非紧光滑流形的乘积都承认完备且一致正标量曲率度量；同时给出两个开放流形乘积不承认完备非负标量曲率的例子。
techniques: 乘积 Morse 指数可加性
无定向 Morse 手术构造
analysis.breakthrough: 显现三因子与两因子之间的存在性分界，改进非紧正标量曲率的构造范围。
analysis.limitations: 正文以三因子 Morse 指数至多 N−3 取得余维至少三的手术；统一曲率下界与完备性还依赖重缩放及长 collar 拼接。 已补读相关主结果和构造或验证方法说明，未逐步复核全部证明；AI 披露另见独立核查记录。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第 2 页披露 GPT 5.6 Sol 与 GPT 6 Astra 用于查找参考文献和改善表述；未披露用于核心想法或证明生成。
